faq.q: What is the origin of Aflatoon?
faq.a: Aflatoon is associated with Arabic. Aflāṭūn is the Arabic form of the Greek name Plato (Πλάτων). The source record's gloss 'Loyal and devoted servant' is unsupported.
Yes — the underlying form أفلاطون is Arabic.
